title: Canavarların da Duyguları Vardır
author: Özlem Fedai Korçak
description: Monsters Have Feelings Too! addresses empathy, emotional awareness, and acceptance of differences. Monsters, contrary to their outward appearance, feel human emotions such as love, fear, and happiness. The story teaches children to accept others without judgment, helps develop emotional intelligence, and encourages children to express their emotions.
